answer.reason: The verses give several events that happened at or to Peniel: Jacob named it after seeing God, Gideon destroyed its tower and men, and Jeroboam built it.

clauses.english: was named by Jacob, who said he had seen God face to face there
clauses.quote: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face

clauses.english: had its tower beaten down and its men slain by Gideon
clauses.quote: he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city
went out from thence, and built Penuel

doubts: The summary already says it was a city in Ephraim, so the Jeroboam clause rests only on the building of it, which is a modest event.
